verdict.rationale: Anthropic's hosting docs list 'observability' as a topic to address when deploying the SDK in production, and hooks/session logs could in principle feed a tracing UI, but there is no first-party UI, dashboard, or full trace of every LLM call/tool invocation documented. A hands-on developer explicitly reports the opposite experience: the SDK's default harness has '0 observability, no extensibility and poor DX' and fails to show full tool-call details in session logs. missing for 10: a documented tracing/observability UI, evidence of per-call LLM/tool trace visualization, and resolution of the community-reported lack of observability.
